description: Blank photoreal scene plates for Punchy. card_roi is the blank card face as fractions of image width/height (0-1).

card_roi_schema.x: left edge of card face, fraction of image width
card_roi_schema.y: top edge of card face, fraction of image height
card_roi_schema.w: card face width, fraction of image width
card_roi_schema.h: card face height, fraction of image height

scene_schema.id: stable string id referenced by cards.json scene_id
scene_schema.aspect: optional label e.g. 10:7 or width/height float

example_roi_placeholders._note: Typical centered landscape card on a table — replace with measured ROI from real plate.
Slightly smaller card in frame with more background margin.
Card fills most of the frame; keep text/holes inside ROI.
